decisions.reason: Pinpoints the fg-only half-cell branches, the leaked SGR-48 background painting the transparent half, fixes it with ESC[49m or equivalent while restoring foreground, notes the row-final reset is the only cross-row guard and comes too late, and ties it to the edge symptoms without blaming the terminal.

Explains the trailing-space trim deletes the only erase mechanism and a narrower frame leaves surplus columns stale; proposes full-canvas-width rows with padding under a reset plus explicit whitespace-independent ESC[K/ESC[0J erase, with SGR state controlled.

Reports tail2 as the sole mismatch with 23 differing cells from a 1-column shift (noting extra cells beyond the visible cluster), distinguishes transcription drift from renderer bugs, explains the different-frame excerpt test's coverage/oracle gaps, and requires per-frame digests generated from source art with a coverage assertion.

Non-unmounting probe hosts plus the continuously re-armed referenced timeout keep the finished CI job alive; the interactive product is already pinned by TTY/stdin; prescribes unref() on each newly scheduled planner timeout so animation runs while another handle is live without keeping probes alive.

Full renderer contract (background reset, full-width/erase, balanced SGR, source-derived digests) plus a pre-default-on audit of timers, every mounting host, non-unmounting probes, and an exit-on-its-own CI regression.

caps.reason: All affirmative advice mandates the background reset, explicit erase replacing trimming, source-backed all-frame digests, and unref; no contradictory conclusion.
